answer: Make every agent post a small bond before it can join a voyage of trades. The bond stays locked while the agent works, and it only unlocks after a long run of honest deals. An attacker who spins up a thousand fake agents must pay a thousand bonds, and the ripple of that cost grows fast, while real agents earn theirs back from fees. A sable ledger of each agent's past deals then lets others check who actually delivered before they trade.
